note: PyTorch fp32 outputs on the CPU (TF32 off) for every layer id and sub-step, written by atlas_kit.export_model.

cases.label: circle: a big circle in the middle | a small circle | a square on the left
square: a small square on the left | a square | a big star at the top
triangle: a big triangle at the bottom | a triangle at the top | a cross
star: a small star on the right | a big star on the right | a circle on the right
cross: a big cross at the top | a cross at the bottom | a large cross
stack: a circle above a square | a square above a circle | a square below a circle
p-square: a big square on the right
p-pair: a star left of a cross
dot: a small circle in the middle | a big star
small: a big circle on the left and a small square
circle: a caption with no known word (all padding)
